title: Cold replay cannot recover a falsely complete association
method: a FAILED append via one Recorder, then a FRESH Recorder instance over the same durable store reads ingestionHealthOf and finalizes
observed: the fresh Recorder reports INGESTION_FAILED from the durable marker and writes UNKNOWN; the validator still refuses with INGESTION_INCOMPLETE
expectedInvariant: cold replay cannot recover a false CLOSED window
remainingUncertainty: the store must be file-backed for a real restart; this test uses an in-memory store shared by two Recorder instances, which exercises the same durable-marker read path
